name: Plain
blurb: Structural, no display type — for unattended generation (fitz.Story) and as a safe fallback

fitz.verifiedBy: Artemis PR-5 probe (fitz.Story / PyMuPDF): Nimbus Sans Regular/Bold embedded+unicode, text readback OK
caveats: fitz ignores inline margin — word boundaries must come from markup (render() now emits a space between adjacent inline elements)
fitz ignores text-transform:uppercase — section labels render as written (Summary, not SUMMARY). ATS-neutral.
fitz drops the hyphen when breaking a line at a hyphen (cross-source → crosssource). Keyword risk; not fixable from CSS without changing text.
fitz emits the fi ligature as U+FB01 — plain sets font-variant-ligatures:none; verify fitz honors it
--density is a custom property fitz does not read; fit on this path uses filter.minPriority / top-N only
fitz.note: plain's tier-A claim (docs/template-contract.md §15) was measured on browser/WeasyPrint output. On the fitz path it holds minus the hyphen-break caveat.

ats.note: Text-layer integrity, not a vendor guarantee. See docs/template-contract.md §5.

generic.method: tools/ats_generic.py — structure-blind heading lexicon over poppler/pdfminer/pypdf, base + 4 mutations (tools/mutate.py)

note_baseBodyPx: 본문 --fs 의 density=1 기준 px. bodyPt = baseBodyPx × density × bodyScale × 0.75 (실측: 12px → 9.0pt)

capacity.measuredWith: dense fixture, no summary, 4 skill groups, tools/fit.py --min-body-pt 10
capacity.note: 본문 10pt 고정·1페이지에서 priority 순으로 남는 bullet 수. tailoring 프롬프트의 분량 힌트로 쓸 것. 요약을 넣으면 1–3 줄어든다. (plain 은 추정치)
